#### Biomass

```{r}
response_variable = "total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2"
```

```{r}
plot.metaecos.points(ds_metaecosystems,
                     metaecosystem_type_i,
                     response_variable,
                     4)
```

```{r}
filtered_data = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  filter(
    system_type %in% metaecosystem_type_i,
    time_point >= first_time_point_model,
    time_point <= last_time_point_model,
    !is.na(!!sym(response_variable))
  )

plot.metaecos.points(filtered_data,
                     metaecosystem_type_i,
                     response_variable,
                     4)
```

<center>[**Null model**]{.underline}</center>

```{r}
null_model = lmer(
  get(response_variable) ~
    day +
    (day | system_nr),
  data = filtered_data,
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead")
)
```

<center>[**Full model**]{.underline} [**(with interaction with time)**]{.underline}</center>

```{r}
full_model = lmer(
  get(response_variable) ~
    day +
    patch_size_ml +
    patch_size_ml : day +
    (day | system_nr),
  data = filtered_data,
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead")
)
```

<details>
  <summary>Click for model output</summary>
```{r}
print(summary(full_model), digits = 1)
```
</details>

```{r}
#Create resid vs fitted
res_vs_fit = filtered_data %>%
    mutate(predicted = fitted(full_model),
           residuals = resid(full_model)) %>%
    plot_ly(x = ~predicted,
            y = ~residuals,
            type = "scatter",
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(size = 5, color = "#4C78A8"),
            text = paste(" ID: ", filtered_data$system_nr, "<br>",
                         "Day: ", filtered_data$day, "<br>",
                         "System Type: ", filtered_data$system_type, "<br>",
                         "Biomass density: ", round(filtered_data$total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2, digits = 2), "<br>"),
            hoverinfo = "text") %>%
    plotly::layout(
        title = "Residuals vs. Fitted Values",
        xaxis = list(title = "Fitted Values"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Residuals")
    )
```

<details>
  <summary>Click for residual plots</summary>
```{r}
res_vs_fit
qqnorm(resid(full_model))
```
</details>

```{r}
model_stats_full = compute.model.stats(full_model,
                                       null_model,
                                       "mixed_model") 

model_stats_full %>%
  mutate(deltaAIC = round(deltaAIC, digits = 1),
         p_value = round(p_value, digits = 3),
         R2 = NULL,
         evidence = "",
         evidence = ifelse(p_value > 0.1, 
                           "none",
                           evidence),
         evidence = ifelse(p_value < 0.1, 
                           "* weak",
                           evidence),
         evidence = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, 
                           "** moderate",
                           evidence),
         evidence = ifelse(p_value < 0.01, 
                           "*** strong",
                           evidence),
         evidence = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, 
                           "**** very strong",
                           evidence),
         p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001,
                           "< 0.001",
                           p_value)) %>%
  print()
```

&nbsp;<br>
&nbsp;<br>
&nbsp;<br>

<center>[**Reduced model**]{.underline} [**(without interaction with time `patch_size_ml`)**]{.underline}</center>

```{r}
reduced_model = lmer(
  get(response_variable) ~
    day +
    patch_size_ml +
    (day | system_nr),
  data = filtered_data,
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead")
)
```
